verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API with a versioned base URL (https://api.otter.ai/v1) for Enterprise workspaces, so the API is versioned at the path level. The same evidence states there is "no version lifecycle beyond the /v1 path," so the deprecation-policy half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a version lifecycle or sunset timelines, changelog or versioning guarantees beyond the /v1 path, a machine-readable spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: base URL https://api.otter.ai/v1 with API-key auth
